story.title: The Language of birds- A folk tale
paragraphs_en: In the land of Czar, lived a lad, He was called Ivan by his stepmom and Dad.
He wanted to learn the language of birds. For he wanted to know the meaning of their words.
He got a boon to understand bird's speech. A grateful eagle was very happy to teach.
Once the boy heard a nightingale sing, “The boy will become a famous king, But his father will be his subject serving.” It pierced his heart like a sting.
The stepmother came to know and hatched a plan. She drugged Ivan unconscious and put him on a plank. Away in the ocean deep When Ivan was in very deep sleep.
A Merchant ship rescued him From the situation grim.
Then he heard the seagulls talk “A brewing storm will soon knock” With Ivan's forewarning, the vessel touched the shore on time The shore was muddy, full of grime
Onshore, Ivan heard Flamingos cry “Coming near was a pirate ship called Blackeye” Along with sailors, Ivan fought bravely They anchored the ship on the coast safely.
Now, he was in Czar's capital town. Czar - the one who wore a big gold crown.
The Czar was anguished because of three crows. He declared “the one who gets rid of these crows... Will marry my daughter, Princess Rose.”
Ivan asked the crows their plight. The crow answered back to his delight. "We shall fly away tonight, Solve this riddle; use all your might."
Ivan solved the riddle of crows And married Princess Rose.
Meanwhile Ivan's father lost money and power, Became a beggar and a pauper.
He came to Ivan's door unknowingly Ivan recognized him instantly.
Ivan remembered the nightingale's song. He hugged his dad and took him along For he was now the Czar - Emperor Ivan the strong.
The story is a folk song To Russia, this story belongs.

sentences.text_en: He came to Ivan's door unknowingly Ivan recognized him instantly.

sentences.text_en: Ivan remembered the nightingale's song.
sentences.text_vi: Ivan nhớ lại bài hát của chim họa mi.
